runtimePage.diagnosticsDescription: Garbage collection and memory reclamation for the current Graft process only.

summary.runtimeAllocDescription: Currently allocated by the Go runtime

fieldDescriptions.runtimeSys: Total memory requested from the system by the Go runtime.
fieldDescriptions.gcCycles: Current snapshot of completed GC cycles.
fieldDescriptions.lastGc: Time of the most recently completed GC cycle; the page states when no cycle has completed.
fieldDescriptions.lastGcPause: Stop-the-world pause duration of the most recently completed GC cycle.
fieldDescriptions.gcPauseTotal: Cumulative GC pause duration since the current process started.
fieldDescriptions.nextGc: Heap allocation target that will trigger the next GC cycle.
fieldDescriptions.heapObjects: Allocated heap objects tracked by the Go runtime.
fieldDescriptions.heapReleased: Heap memory returned by the Go runtime to the operating system.
fieldDescriptions.stackInUse: Memory currently occupied by Go stacks.
fieldDescriptions.observedAt: Timestamp of the latest aggregated snapshot.
fieldDescriptions.loadAverage: 1m / 5m / 15m load averages from the current server.
